title: Removes postal code for card payments in certain regions on Checkout and Payment Element
summary: A postal code is no longer collected for all card payments on Checkout and Payment Element in the following regions: Previously, the postal code was always collected for card payments in the following scenarios:
migrationNotes: If you currently rely on the postal code for customers in the affected regions and don’t have automatic_tax enabled, make the changes necessary to collect this field manually:
For Checkout Sessions, you can set billing_address_collection to required. However, this will collect the full billing address and affect other payment methods and regions.
For Payment Element, you need to add your own custom fields for country and postal code, as well as set billingDetails.address to never.
